fields.recipient: Eastgate Home Stores, Receiving, 400 Depot Road, Eastgate
fields.reason: One lot tested positive for Listeria monocytogenes.
fields.hazard: May cause serious illness, especially in people with weakened immune systems.
instructions: Stop selling the product and remove it from shelves and storage immediately.
Notify your own customers if you resold it.
Return the reply form even if you have none of the product.
